corrections.issue: The general rule 'flow surges into a theme often mark the profit-taking phase' is the first reader's extrapolation. Sohn only describes energy: money flooded in after the 27 February move, people are now taking profits, oil peaked at about the same time ('perhaps, who knows'), and the 14 June deal announcement then collapsed oil and energy stocks.
corrections.fix: Energy ETF flows surged after the 27 February military move and were fading as people took profits, around the oil peak; the Sunday deal announcement then collapsed oil and energy stocks. Sohn treats this as an energy-specific observation, not a general rule about flow surges.

completeness_estimate: 0.85 - first reader captured nearly every chart read, data point and the concentration, leveraged-ETF and flow arguments accurately; missed methodology and caveat points (revealed versus stated behaviour, proxy weighting choice, Meta bearish-call humility, options for no-edge charts), the small-cap neglect cause, discretionary sub-areas, Nvidia versus staples size, the 2-year yield remark and Eisman's closing AI-hardware synthesis
